components.css: .ds-booth-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;color:#141414}.ds-rim{display:grid;place-items:center;width:84px;height:84px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#fff,#c9ccd1 45%,#7d8188);box-shadow:0 10px 24px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.55)}.ds-cap{width:62px;height:62px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 40% 35%,#3a3a3a,#0d0d0d 70%);box-shadow:inset 0 -4px 8px rgba(255,255,255,.08),0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.55);transition:transform .15s}.ds-booth-btn:hover .ds-cap{transform:scale(1.03)}.ds-booth-btn:active .ds-cap{transform:translateY(2px)}.ds-booth-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #141414;outline-offset:4px;border-radius:999px}.ds-booth-label{font:800 1.7rem/1 'Big Shoulders Display',sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase}

narrative.overview: GoFocus is a studio that photographs birthdays, recitals, matches, restaurants and portraits, so the site is the photo booth every party guest knows. Brushed-aluminium grey owns the big surfaces, the black interior holds the work, and each album is shown as a printed strip of four frames. Pressing the chrome button counts down, flashes and prints a strip from the next album.
keyCharacteristics: Committed grey fields alternating with black
Every album is a printed photo strip
One authored motion: the stepped print feed
Only transform and opacity move, for Safari

rules.name: The One Hue Rule
rules.body: Grey is the only interface colour; the photographs supply every other colour.

rules.name: The Whole Field Rule
rules.body: Grey and black are whole alternating sections, never thin accents on a neutral page.

rules.name: The Signage Rule
rules.body: Display type is large, condensed, uppercase and packed tight, never a timid heading.

dos: Do show every album as a Photo Strip with its real photos and count.
Do animate only transform and opacity; print strips with steps(16).
Do honour reduced motion: no countdown or flash.
donts: Don't use live backdrop blur over moving content, animated filters or heavy 3D on this surface.
Don't add a second accent colour, gradient text or labels above headings.
Don't invent prices, testimonials or client logos.
